releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.44 — the chat list and the Groups tab now survive a restart the same way the conversations already did. Lists used to be written to disk in exactly one place, at the end of a successful refresh, so anything that happened in between — a message arriving, a chat pinned, a group renamed, a conversation started with someone outside the friend list — was memory-only and rolled back if the app was killed. They are now mirrored to disk within a second and painted before the network answers, and the Groups tab has its own cache (including member rosters, so group bubbles still have author names offline). The red 'couldn't load your chats' banner is gone while the phone has no network: the list is saved and complete, and the 'Waiting for network' pill already says the only thing worth saying. Neither cache is ever written from a half-failed refresh, so one bad request can no longer erase the half that did answer.
